2608.24876.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
2608.24876.paper_summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes failures to specific memory components. Across tasks, a fixed Meta-Agent turns that evidence into localized, validation-gated updates to Skill Memory that reshape execution and yield new evidence, forming a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop. Across four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, Recuris improves task success in 35 of the 37 completed model-benchmark pairs, carrying frontier models to SOTA-level task success: on tau-bench it adds +17.8 points to GPT-5.6 Sol and +15.6 to Claude Opus 5, taking Opus 5 to 87.9%, and +16.6/+13.5 points on Qwen3.6-27B/35B on SkillFlow. The advantage widens as the interaction horizon grows, to +32.2 points on the longest tasks, and common long-horizon failures fall by up to 80%. These results position recursively evolving memory as a scalable foundation for RSI, enabling agents to continuously transform accumulated experience into increasingly effective long-horizon behavior. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris
2608.24876.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸自我改進（RSI）在長期任務中仍然困難，因為不斷增長的歷史會模糊任務狀態並使技能調用不對齊。<lb/>我們介紹了 Recuris，一種遞歸的經驗工作記憶架構，用於長期代理的利用，其中工作記憶跟踪任務進展並指導從經驗記憶中選擇技能，將技能的使用基於當前需求而非完整歷史。<lb/>這種耦合還將執行轉變為結構化的證據，將失敗定位到特定的記憶組件。<lb/>在各項任務中，一個固定的元代理將這些證據轉化為局部的、驗證門控的技能記憶更新，重塑執行並產生新的證據，形成一個有界的遞歸記憶演化循環。<lb/>在四個長期基準和十個模型中，Recuris 在37個完成的模型-基準對中提高了35個任務的成功率，將前沿模型推向SOTA級別的任務成功：在tau-bench上，它為GPT-5.6 Sol增加了+17.8分，為Claude Opus 5增加了+15.6分，使Opus 5達到87.9%，在SkillFlow上對Qwen3.6-27B/35B分別增加了+16.6/+13.5分。<lb/>隨著互動範圍的增長，優勢擴大，在最長的任務上達到+32.2分，常見的長期失敗減少了多達80%。<lb/>這些結果將遞歸演變的記憶定位為RSI的可擴展基礎，使代理能夠持續將累積的經驗轉化為越來越有效的長期行為。<lb/>代碼：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris
